List Of Best Accessories For Samsung Galaxy S20, S20+, And S20 Ultra 

If you have recently bought one of the Samsung flagship mobiles, this article is for you. Here are some of the best accessories for Samsung Galaxy S20, S20+, and S20 Ultra. No matter whether you want to play games, capture photos, do videography or listen to music, you can do it better with the help of these affordable accessories. 

Although these mobiles have almost everything you might need to have on a mobile, you can enhance the experience with the help of these third-party gadgets. 

Best Accessories For Samsung Galaxy S20, S20+, And S20 Ultra 

1] Case 

You should always protect your mobile as much as possible – no matter whether it is your hard-earned money or your dad gave you to purchase it. An excellent mobile case should protect your mobile from accidental drops and scratches. As these three mobiles are quite expensive, you should buy a good back cover and install that respectively. An excellent mobile case for S20 can cost around $25-30, and you can save a lot of money on your mobile by using a simple case. You can check out this article to find out some of the best cases for Samsung Galaxy S20, S20+, and S20 Ultra. 

2] Galaxy Buds+ 

Galaxy Buds+ is an AirPods alternative that you can use with your latest Samsung mobile. The best thing is that Samsung has made these wireless headphones. Therefore, you should not get any issue while using it with your mobile – no matter whether it S20, S20+, or S20 Ultra. They are quite comfortable, and the audio quality is pretty good too. No matter whether you like to listen to bass or classical music, you can find it very handy. Also, the price of these headphones is not very high. You can purchase it for $103 from the Amazon website. You can find three color variants – White, Black, and Sky Blue. 

3] Galaxy Watch Active 2 

Galaxy Watch Active2 is a SmartWatch that you can purchase for Rs. 36K in India. It is a simple yet convenient smartwatch from Samsung that is compatible with all the mobiles, as mentioned above. No matter whether you want to use it for checking times or tracking daily activities, it does everything on the go. The aluminum and stainless steel have made the build quality top-notch. The overall appearance of Galaxy Watch Active2 is excellent, and it looks premium on anybody’s hand. You can find three color combinations – Black, Silver, and Pink. 

4] Power Bank 

All these mobiles have a perfect camera, and it is inevitable that you will go for a trip to capture photos and record videos only. If so, you are going to consume a lot of battery in a short time. To spruce up your experience, you can use a power bank to recharge your mobile on the go. There are many manufacturers, but only some of them are good enough for your mobile. As you have a high-end battery, you should purchase something in the 20000mAh range. If you buy a 10000mAh or 5000mAh power battery, it won’t support your mobile for very long. You have two options in your hand. You can go to a local store and purchase something for your mobile. Second, you can check out these power banks. 

  • Xiaomi 20000mAh: Rs. 1499
  • Ambrane20000mAh: Rs. 1299 
  • URBN 20000mAh: Rs. 899

5] Smart LED View Cover 

If you want to upgrade the look of your existing Samsung mobile, you should check out this cover called Smart LED View Cover. As the name defines, it shows LED lights to display the time on the front side of your mobile. Apart from that, it something more so that you can enhance the appearance of your latest mobile, S20, S20+, or S20 Ultra. As it shows white LED lights, you cannot find this cover in light colors. For your information, you can purchase either Black or Gray – it depends upon your taste. You should know that this case costs more than other regular cases. That said, you need to pay around Rs. 3200 for the Samsung Galaxy S20 case. Check the deal 

6] Smart Clear View Cover 

Smart Clear View Cover is another handy mobile cover that you can use to show notifications smartly when your phone is locked. By default, Samsung S20, S20+, and S20 Ultra show all the notifications on the lock screen like any other mobile. If you want to have a mobile cover and it should show the notifications differently, you can check out this cover. No matter whether you have got missed calls, emails, WhatsApp messages, or anything else, it displays the corresponding icon on your secondary screen. Like the above-mentioned cover, Smart Clear View Cover is available in two different colors – Black and Gray. The best thing is that you can get the same cover for all three mobiles. 

7] Amkette Evo Gamepad Pro

Amkette Evo Gamepad Pro is a gaming controller that you can use to play games on your mobile. Some games require multiple taps at a time. If you are playing such a game, you can check out this controller that has multiple buttons that you can assign to various tasks and do your job accordingly. It looks like the PS4 controller and the buttons are smooth enough so that you can press them as per your requirements and do not miss anything during the gameplay. The best thing about this controller is that you can attach your mobile to play racing games. On Amazon, it is priced at Rs. 2099. Check the deal 

The accessory list varies from person to person. If you like to record videos, you might need a selfie stick, lens, etc. If you play games a lot, you might need a gaming controller. 

Do let us know about your favorite accessory for Samsung Galaxy S20, S20+, and S20 Ultra.
